name: Ruby of the War Mage

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Fixed to a weapon, it lets the weapon serve as your Spellcasting Focus.
text: Press this rune-etched ruby, 1 inch across, against a Simple or Martial weapon for at least 10 minutes to bind it there; afterward that weapon can serve as your Spellcasting Focus when you cast spells. (The game already treats material components and focuses as always available.)
